children: Fractyl Health reported Revita met the six-month co-primary endpoint, retaining ~80% of GLP-1–induced weight loss vs 67% for sham (p=0.0023).
In mITT (N=308) Revita mean weight regain 5.1% vs 8.2% for sham; treatment difference highly significant (p=0.0023).
32% of Revita patients were weight‑stable or lost more at 6 months vs 18% for sham (post hoc; nominal p=0.020).
Dose‑dependent effect: ≥20 cm ablation regained 3.8% vs 8.2% for sham (53% less regain; nominal p=0.003).
Interim safety: no device- or procedure-related serious adverse events, no deaths, most related AEs were mild and peri‑procedural.
Next steps: company plans De Novo submission late Q4 2026 and topline 12‑month data expected Q1 2027.
